The second architecture used the Inception-v3 architecture to extract spatial features, which were then input to bi-directional LSTMs, achieving an accuracy of 96.0% on four languages: English, German, French, and Spanish.
turns.rag_answer: Bartz et al. proposed two different hybrid Convolutional Recurrent Neural Networks (CNN-RNN) for language identification. The first architecture extracts spatial features from log-Mel spectra of raw audio using CNNs and captures temporal features with RNNs, achieving 91.0% accuracy on the Youtube News Dataset. The second architecture employs the Inception-v3 model for spatial feature extraction.
